card.name: The digit 9 inside years and ranges
card.fires_on: The digit 9 as the second digit of a year starting with 1 (such as 1967 or 1985). It also fires on the 9 or the decimal point in numeric ranges like 26 to 29 or 0.70 – 0.89.

modes.label: Upper end of a range
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside the top value of a numeric range, such as a weight or age band.

card.writes: It suppresses the digit tokens 0 to 5, so the next token is less likely to be a plain digit.
